name: Respacio Import For RH RealHomes
author: Respacio real estate CRM

sections.description:
Manage all your property listings and contacts from Respacio to take your real estate sales and marketing to the next level. From multinational franchises to sole traders, the Respacio CRM is used by successful real estate agents and developers all over the world to sell and rent properties.

This plugin is designed to import your properties from the Respacio CRM and then feed them back to your RealHomes website, allowing you to manage your properties from within the Respacio CRM. The plugin makes changes to the content of data tables in your WordPress installation. It does not affect the RealHomes theme design, functionality, CSS or any other element of your site.

Respacio will also feed properties out to property portals such as Rightmove, Zoopla, Idealista, Realtor.CA or systems like Facebook to create a property catalogue… using the Feedbuilder module you can connect synchronise XML and JSON feeds to almost anywhere. This means you can also feed in properties directly from partner agents, MLS systems etc and then feed these properties out to your websites. You can also apply feeds to contacts.

New enquiries from websites, property portals and other online sources enter your Respacio system automatically, no typing using the API, Plugins or automated inbuilt email reader. Respacio comes with hundreds of possible automations to speed up your business flow. Immediately send automated WhatsApp replies and boost your retention rates.

Team management, pipelines, deals, GSuite integration, emails, calendars, newsletters, reports: Respacio allows real estate businesses to take control, measure and refine their digital marketing and sales processes.

Despite all its amazing functionality, Respacio is simple to use, low cost and will make an immediate impact on your sales and marketing performance. This plugin requires a subscription to the Respacio Contact and Property Management system

To use this plugin, you will need an account with Respacio. Find out more about Respacio pricing and plans and get a free trial here.

Respacio is GDPR compliant. If you use Respacio your data will be managed accordingly, please see our privacy policy and Terms of Service.

This plugin requires that you are running the WP Realhomes theme. You can connect Respacio using many other themes, you don’t even need to connect a real estate theme. Contact us with your project details and we’ll help you.
sections.installation:
Upload plugin from WordPress backend plugin menu and activate and for api key for import and also export from them

e.g.

  1. Upload the plugin files to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/respacio-import-for-rh-real-homes’ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the ‘Respacio RealHomes RH Import’ from side menu screen to import or export from WordPress backend
sections.faq:
What does the plugin do?

This plugin imports properties from Respacio CRM using the API into your WP Realhomes installation. Properties in Respacio can then be sent back to the website and when a property is added, removed or edited those changes will show on the website.
